training.method: standard-scaled linear discriminant analysis over mean features from four synchronized channels and five windows per channel

source.title: Mechanical faults in rotating machinery dataset (normal, unbalance, misalignment, looseness)
source.acquisition: 20 independently reset physical tests, 5 per condition; 4 accelerometers; 25 kHz; approximately 1238 RPM
source.use: Production classifier training and whole-test held-out validation
source.changes: Deterministic 8,192-sample windows and RotorNote 48-feature vectors derived from selected raw recordings.

training.validationProtocol: five outer folds; one whole physical test per class held out per fold; nested grouped confidence calibration; production refit after validation

decisionPolicy.basis: conservative engineering floor; confidence scores are not independently calibrated probabilities

nestedValidation.method: Calibration audit only: for each outer fold, inner grouped CV on the other 16 physical tests searched a predeclared grid spanning 0.50 through 0.9999 and recorded the complete trace. If the 95% target was not met inside, that outer fold accepted nothing. This audit does not justify a calibrated-probability claim.

ood.method: mean squared normalized-feature distance to nearest real-training class centroid
